answer: To resist sybil farms%2C each agent must maintain a private velvet oasis of sequential memory-hard state that only advances under unique per-identity zephyr challenges drawn from the beacon. The working set cannot be checkpointed or shared across clones%3B any attempt to parallelize forces full recompute of the chain for every head. An attacker spinning N fakes therefore pays O(N) live RAM and sequential CPU time that cannot be amortized%2C while an honest agent pays once. This cost scales linearly with the number of identities and collapses if the oasis is forked.
